LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainwashHelmet.label: Mugirl Brainwashing Helmet
LanguageData.MooGirl_MagneticShackles.label: Mugirl Magnetic Shackles
LanguageData.MooGirl_MagneticShackles.description: A high-tech restraint developed by a space-age megacorporation, combining a collar and handcuffs. Its internal magnetic mechanism activates intermittently, pulling the wearer's hands to the neck, forming a shackle-like posture. This design exhibits a distinct whimsicality, intended for observing the Mugirl's flustered reactions when suddenly restrained. Removal requires a [Spacer Restraint Key], and after unlocking, the device can be further decoded using a [Restraint Decryptor]. The decoded shackles will no longer activate automatically but can be manually activated or deactivated by the controller.
LanguageData.MooGirl_ShockCollar.label: Mugirl Electric Shock Collar
LanguageData.MooGirl_ShockCollar.description: A control-oriented restraint specially designed by a space-age megacorporation, appearing as a metal collar fitted tightly around the neck. Its internal electrodes intermittently release electric currents to shock the wearer, featuring both mild and severe modes. This unpredictable stimulation is often used to maintain discipline and demonstrate control. Removal requires a [Spacer Restraint Key], and after unlocking, the device can be further decoded using a [Restraint Decryptor]. The decoded collar will no longer deliver random shocks but can be manually triggered by the controller, with free selection of shock mode.
